body.statement: For every \(c>0\), positive \(b\), and \(u,z\in\mathbb R^K\), \(\ell_{c,b}(u,z)=c\,\mathrm{KL}\{q_{c,b}(u+z)\|q_{c,b}(u)\}\) and \(\ell_{c,b}(u,z)=c^{-1}\int_0^1s\,z^{\top}C\{q_{c,b}(u+sz)\}z\,ds\). Consequently, \(0\le\ell_{c,b}(u,z)\le\operatorname{osc}(z)\) and \(0\le c\ell_{c,b}(u,z)\le\operatorname{osc}(z)^2/8\).
body.justification: The exact identity fixes the regret normalization and provides an integrable envelope uniformly over temperature.
body.gap: Fang--Ridder--Xie uses second-order regret at a fixed smooth optimum; the exact categorical identity over the complete temperature scale is not its theorem.
body.consumer: The path coupling and certified tail truncation both use the global oscillation bounds.
